name: Abell 30 (Hubble)
blurb: Abell 30, a born-again planetary nebula, seen by Hubble.
label: pna6630-hubble
story: The star at the center of this planetary nebula flared back to life late in its career and threw out knots of helium- and carbon-rich material. Its wind now streams past those knots, sculpting them into tail-like shapes.

claims.text: During the born-again phase it expelled knots of helium and carbon-rich material
A fast wind streams past the knots, forming tail-like structures
PN-A66-30 is the archive label for this planetary nebula
